urls.rationale: Gov Code Title 3 Subtitle A Ch. 305 (Registration of Lobbyists) - full lobbying-disclosure statute body, directory-level leaf.

notes: Tree depth = 5 (state -> code -> title -> subtitle -> chapter). Intermediate pass-2 fetches required at title-3/ and then subtitle-a/. Compared to TX 2009 (subtitle-c-chapter-305), TX 2015 places Ch. 305 under subtitle-a (Legislature).
